The loop
1 Set up Your agent Prompt, skills and tools, read as rules.
2 Generate Tests, written by code Every pair of situations, covered.
3 Judge A mixture of judges A cheap judge first, the right expert next.
4 Diagnose The step that broke A failure names its step and its source.
5 Improve Fix the setup Edit the prompt, a skill or a tool text.
6 Rerun Only what changed The blast radius of the edit.
Edit, rerun what changed, judge again.
